title: Affine spectrum ordinary stalk comparison square
statement: Let $f:X\to S$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$, $g:S\prime\to S$, and $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ be a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], whose spectrum maps on global sections also form a cartesian square. Fix derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], a complex $P$ of modules on $X$, a point $z_0\in\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X\prime,\top)$, and $i\in\mathbf Z$. Put $j=X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $j\prime=X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $z=j\prime(z_0)$, $P_0=j^*P$ and $P_g=(g\prime)^*P$, all pullbacks termwise. Let $\alpha:(g_0\prime)^*P_0\cong(j\prime)^*P_g$ be the canonical adjunction-mate composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], using isoSpec naturality. Let $b$ and $b_0$ be the respective localized base-derived tensor cohomology comparisons [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model, def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], followed by tensorStalkIso and comparisonStalkHomologyIso.inv, but without the inverse pullback counit along $g\prime$ or $g_0\prime$. Write $H_0$ for spectrum stalk cohomology, $F,F_0$ for scalar forgetting, $T$ for isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso [lem-pc-iso-pullback-stalk-cohomology], and $\epsilon_{j\prime}$ for isoPullbackComplexCounitIso. There exists an additive isomorphism $l:F(\mathrm{source}(b))\cong F_0(\mathrm{source}(b_0))$ such that $l;F_0(b_0)=F(b);T_{Q(P_g)};F_0H_0(\epsilon_{j\prime,P_g};Q(\alpha^{-1}))$. No K-flatness or invertibility of either comparison is assumed. In particular this is an ordinary pullback comparison square, with no composition comparison for derived pullback along $g\prime$.

proof.text: Obtain compatible stalk ring equivalences and the input and ordinary tensor chain isomorphisms q and t from the affine spectrum tensor coordinates theorem.

Apply the localized derived tensor naturality theorem under the four compatible ring isomorphisms. It supplies an additive source isomorphism l and the square with the localized comparison and inverse exact restriction homology map. The proved private categorical assembly lemma postcomposes with exact restriction homology and tensorStalkIso0, and cancels the inverse followed by the hom map.

Use the ordinary tensor coordinate equation. The private ordinary_stalk_transport_eq follows by evaluating the localization lift at Q(Pg), unfolding the explicit ordinary stalk homology isomorphism and cancelling the exact coordinate pullback counit. Naturality of comparisonStalkHomologyIso for alpha.inv, followed by its inverse and the explicit comparisonIntoTensorPullback definition, yields the unchanged displayed square. The private homology_inverse_square and assemble_comparison_square lemmas contain the categorical cancellation, and functoriality rewrites the composite maps in comparisonIntoTensorPullback.

theorem exists_affineSpectrum_ordinaryComparison_square
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (z0 : Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) (i : ℤ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    let z := X'.isoSpec.inv z0
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let Pg := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let H0 := comparisonStalkCohomology (Spec Γ(X', ⊤)) z0 i
    let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X'.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let F0 := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).presheaf.stalk z0))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    ∃ l : F.obj (Arrow.mk (comparisonIntoTensorPullback f f' g g' sq z P i)).left ≅
        F0.obj (Arrow.mk
          (comparisonIntoTensorPullback (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
            (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 P0 i)).left,
      l.hom ≫ F0.map
        (comparisonIntoTensorPullback (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
          (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0 z0 P0 i) =
      F.map (comparisonIntoTensorPullback f f' g g' sq z P i) ≫
        (isoPullbackStalkCohomologyIso X'.isoSpec.inv z0 i).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Pg) ≫
        F0.map (H0.map ((isoPullbackComplexCounitIso X'.isoSpec.inv).hom.app Pg ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (affineSpectrumTensorComplexIso g' P).inv))
